transcript: So there was a disagreement with our designer about a launch campaign. We were launching a new product line and I wanted the ads to show the price really big, because our research said customers were price-sensitive. The designer, Quan, felt that made it look cheap and he wanted a lifestyle image with the price small in the corner. We went back and forth a few times on Slack, which, um, probably wasn't the best place for it, it got a bit short. In the end we got on a call. I explained why price mattered to me and he showed me some examples from competitors that looked kind of cheap with the big price. I could see his point, actually. We agreed to run both versions for a week and see which one did better. The lifestyle one got more clicks, but the price one got more purchases, if I remember right. So we kind of combined them for the rest of the campaign. It worked out okay. Next time I'd suggest testing earlier, instead of arguing first.
